source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary: After an enemy unit finishes a **[normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move)**, **[advance move](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move)** or **[fall-back move](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back)** up to 8" from a **DEATH GUARD** unit of yours that is up to 6" from this model, if no enemy units are in [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of that **DEATH GUARD** unit, it can move up to 5" in a **[normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move)**.

trigger.event: enemy unit completes Normal, Advance or Fall Back move
